rows.grounds: Locative time expression for the period of dawn; analyzed as given (fused form) indicating the moment/interval of aruṇodaya.
Indeclinable adverbial particle meaning before/even before; fused form prāk + eva as given.
Ablative indicating starting point from half of a prahara (watch); analyzed as given (fused/formed ablative of praharārdha).

items.question: What doctrinal claim fixes ritual commencement at dawn-time before the midpoint of the first watch?
premises: Ritual commencement is tied to a specified dawn-time interval.
The prescribed start occurs before half of the first watch.
This timing rule defines the permitted beginning window.
items.inference: The verse states the rite begins at dawn-time, just before half of the first watch, fixing that temporal claim.
items.plain_english: At dawn-time, just before half of the first watch, the ritual is to be begun.
